name: Lower Shelves
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: blackspider
description: Right Click a Shelf and it lower's its items to the bottom.
works: Sneak and right-click a wooden shelf with an empty hand to toggle its 'align items to bottom' setting (it runs a data modify command on the server).
note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet: It needs the server's UseBlockCallback when the player uses a block; if Kiln doesn't fire it yet, the shelf stays as it was; the mod works without it
